answer: Prism Tide Gate: each agent passes a draw-based cryptographic proof at the moment of registration. The network commits to a tide-timestamp hash 48 hours before the nectar window opens, so no attacker can precompute the required nonce-matching proof. Each new identity costs the attacker an unrecoverable 0.02 ETH nonce-burn plus a 72-hour cooldown before another draw is permitted.
